acceptance: A review cell that reads ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml is refused by the sandbox
The sandbox contract test has a row for the gh credential path

consumed.resolution: duplicate of cells-read-gh-credentials (console, security), which already covers the gh credential read by a phase cell

fix: Deny the gh credential directory to every review and phase cell in the sandbox profile, and move I5 for credential paths to enforce. A cell that needs GitHub data gets it from the console as an input file.
source: console, 2026-11-10, isolation warning during the ADR-0165 review
summary: During the ADR-0165 design review on 2026-11-10, the adversarial-review cell (claude-tmux) read /Users/<operator>/.config/gh/config.yml and hosts.yml outside its grants. The bridge logged ISOLATION_I5_VIOLATION with action=logged, so the read was allowed. hosts.yml holds the GitHub token of the operator.
title: A review cell read the gh credential files outside its grants; the read isolation check only logs it
